==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

[[Siuan]] ponders on who she can trust. [[Nynaeve]] says she doesn't think they can trust [[Moiraine]]. Siuan questions whether Nynaeve has enough experience in the world to really know who to trust. She does believe they can trust Moiraine, and thinks they know more than they think they do. Siuan says she wishes she could raise Nynaeve to the shawl. After beating around the bush, Siuan says they are all she has to work with. They are the only ones she can be absolutely sure are not [[Black Ajah]] since [[Liandrin Guirale|Liandrin]] had tried to harm them. Since no one will believe the Amyrlin is collaborating with those she humiliated publicly with these punishments, (and she can trust them) they are to be her hounds. Egwene and Nynaeve are to hunt the Black Ajah for the Amyrlin. Siuan does not assign the task to [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] even though she trusts her also, since Siuan must be able to tell [[Morgase Trakand|Morgase]] that she did not bring any more danger to her.

Egwene is astounded and says they would surely be over matched; she also has too many tasks already between her punishments, studies and talking to [[Anaiya Carel|Anaiya]] about her dreams. But Siuan insists and tells them that they will have to do their investigating between their other duties, and within their limited power as Accepted. Nynaeve points out that since any of the sisters teaching them could be a [[Darkfriend]], it would be safer to try to find them now than wait for their plots to unfold. As a concession, the Amyrlin gives them papers that have written on them: "what the bearer does is done by my authority. Obey, and keep silent, at my command. Signed, the Amyrlin Seat." They can use them in situations of utmost need, but they will have to be careful they are not trying to use those orders with [[Darkfriend|Darkfriends.]] Nynaeve is amused at the idea of ordering [[Lan Mandragoran|Lan]] with the orders.

Siuan says [[Verin]] will give them all the information they need on Liandrin and the other Black Ajah sisters. Egwene and Nynaeve are dismissed with reminders that they have to visit [[Sheriam]] and work in the kitchen.
